transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before I publish the final staffing roster for the coordination cell, we need to run our routine pre-exercise qualification scrub with personnel, logistics, and signal staff. Let's start by confirming the qualifications of our available personnel — Sgt Malik, Cpl Ortiz, and Spc Vega — against the three desk requirements: partner liaison, POL accountability, and movement control. Who has the current qualification data for these three soldiers?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Maj. Carter, as S-1 I can confirm that Sgt Malik is the only one of the three available personnel with a current host-nation language qualification, making Malik the qualified choice for the partner-liaison desk. I verified the renewal in the personnel database this morning, though the updated qualification export is not yet on the S-3 briefing slide.
